policy.text: The disposal request must authorize certified destruction. Once that condition holds, the certificate must cover at least 90 percent of the submitted media. Apply these requirements in the stated order. At the first unavailable value, refer the claim for review. Reject at the first known violation. Approve when both requirements are met. Cite this policy and the record for every check through the decisive check.

Only a staff badge qualifies; check the credential registry first. Then verify at most 3 replacements, this request included, during the current badge year. Apply these requirements in the stated order. At the first unavailable value, refer the claim for review. Reject at the first known violation. Approve when both requirements are met. Cite this policy and the record for every check through the decisive check.

A bicycle service claim must first be tied to a company fleet bicycle. Then check the documented service subtotal against the maximum of 8000 cents. Apply these requirements in the stated order. At the first unavailable value, refer the claim for review. Reject at the first known violation. Approve when both requirements are met. Cite this policy and the record for every check through the decisive check.

Check the delivered translation first: at least 350 translated words must have been delivered. The rights authorization must then cover internal distribution. Apply these requirements in the stated order. At the first unavailable value, refer the claim for review. Reject at the first known violation. Approve when both requirements are met. Cite this policy and the record for every check through the decisive check.
